meta.name: Email Application Tracker — Design System
meta.description: Design tokens, component specs, and page blueprints for the Email Application Tracker frontend. Derived from the approved low-fidelity wireframe and leveled up to a production system. Built to be consumed by an AI coding agent (Cursor).

targetStack.styling: CSS variables (generate :root from cssVariables block) OR Tailwind (map tokens into theme.extend)
targetStack.dataFetching: TanStack Query (React Query) against the FastAPI backend

meta.note: GET /stats is served at the site root (/stats), every other endpoint is under /api/v1.

designIntent.feel: Calm, dense-but-legible enterprise tooling. Neutral stone foundation with a single indigo accent reserved for interactive intent. Flat surfaces defined by hairline borders rather than heavy shadows.
principles: Restraint: color is information, not decoration. Spend it on actions, focus, and status only.
Hairline structure: separate regions with 1px stone borders and whitespace, not drop shadows. Shadows appear only on overlay surfaces (drawer).
Monospace = machine data. Use the mono family for IDs, timestamps, API paths, and code so they read as data at a glance.
One bold element per view. Everything else stays quiet.
Every empty/loading/error state is designed, never a blank panel.
doNot: No gradients on surfaces or buttons.
No shadows on cards/metrics/tables; borders only.
No more than one solid high-contrast button per section.
Do not invent new accent hues; statuses use the defined semantic palette.

neutralScale.description: Tailwind 'stone' scale. The product's structural foundation.

primaryScale.description: Indigo. The single interactive accent: focus rings, links, selected states, active chart series, progress.

semanticAliases.description: Aliases that components reference. Map these to CSS variables.

fontFamily.mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

bodySm.use: table cells, form controls, nav items, buttons

spacing.description: px scale. Use these for padding, gap, and margins.

radius.comment_sm: bars, small tags, status pill chips

borderWidth.comment: 1.5px for dashed chart frames and brand glyph

elevation.comment_flat: Default for cards, metrics, tables — borders only.

breakpoints.comment_md: Below this the sidebar collapses to an off-canvas drawer and multi-column grids stack to one column.

cssVariables.comment: Paste-ready :root block. Generate this from tokens. Components below reference these names.

applicationStatus.comment: Status badge styling, keyed by application status. Use full radius pill.

appShell.structure: Two-column grid: fixed sidebar + fluid main. Main contains a sticky topbar and a scrolling page region.
appShell.responsive: Below 820px: hide the static sidebar, expose it as an off-canvas drawer via a hamburger in the topbar; page padding drops to 16px.

AppShell.notes: Sidebar and Topbar persist across routes; only the page region swaps.

NavItem.base: display:flex; gap:9px; padding:8px 9px; radius: var(--radius-md); font:13.5px; color: var(--color-text-2); leading icon 15px (lucide)

Topbar.breadcrumb: 13px; trailing segment is current page in var(--color-text) semibold

HealthIndicator.desc: Status dot + label bound to GET /api/v1/health

Avatar.menu: click opens user menu with sign out

PageHeader.structure: title (pageTitle) + optional subtitle (meta, var(--color-text-3)) on the left; action buttons right-aligned

Card.base: background: var(--color-surface); border:1px solid var(--color-line); radius: var(--radius-md); padding:16px; position:relative; elevation: flat

Button.base: font:13px; radius: var(--radius-md); padding:7px 13px; border:1px solid; cursor:pointer; transition: background var(--duration-fast)

variants.primary: background: var(--color-inverse); color: var(--color-on-inverse); border-color: var(--color-inverse); hover: brightness(1.15)
variants.secondary: background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); border-color: var(--color-line-strong); hover: background var(--color-sunken)
variants.ghost: transparent; no border; color: var(--color-text-2); hover: background var(--color-sunken)
variants.danger: background: var(--color-surface); color: #b91c1c; border-color: #fecaca; hover: background #fef2f2

Input.base: border:1px solid var(--color-line); radius: var(--radius-md); height:34px; padding:0 11px; font:13px; background: var(--color-surface)

Select.base: like Input with borderStrong; trailing chevron (lucide chevron-down); min-width 150px
Select.use: status editing on detail + promote drawer

FilterPill.base: inline-flex; radius: var(--radius-full); padding:4px 11px; font:12px; border:1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-2)

states.active: background var(--color-inverse); color var(--color-on-inverse); border-color var(--color-inverse)

FilterPill.use: status filters on Applications, classification filters on Emails

Toolbar.desc: Horizontal row: search Input (flex:1) + FilterPills / Select dropdowns

Table.th: caption type (11px uppercase semibold var(--color-text-3)); padding 0 12px 10px; border-bottom 1px var(--color-line)
Table.td: padding 12px; border-bottom 1px var(--color-line); color var(--color-text-2); font 13px
Table.rowClickable: cursor pointer; hover background var(--color-sunken); first cell var(--color-text) medium
Table.a11y: Use real <table>/<thead>/<tbody>; if rows navigate, make the primary cell a real link for keyboard users.
Table.footer: results count (meta) left, Prev/Next secondary buttons right

StatusBadge.base: inline-block; font:11px; padding:3px 9px; radius: var(--radius-full); border:1px solid

ChartLineContainer.desc: Card holding 'Applications over time' line chart
ChartLineContainer.implementation: recharts LineChart; single series uses var(--color-accent); axes/grid in var(--color-line); minHeight 150px
ChartLineContainer.wireframeNote: Wireframe shows a dashed placeholder — replace with the live chart.

StatusDonut.implementation: recharts PieChart innerRadius~50%; slices use neutralScale steps with one accent for the dominant; legend lists statuses

BarList.implementation: each row: label + proportional bar (var(--color-fill) track); width = value/max

Timeline.desc: Vertical list of linked email events on application detail
Timeline.implementation: left rail 1.5px var(--color-line); node 9px circle borderStrong; each item: subject + timestamp(mono meta)

KeyValueList.desc: Two-column label/value grid for detail + promote forms

Drawer.desc: Right-side slide-in panel. Primary surface for promoting an email to an application.
Drawer.frame: position:fixed; top:0; right:0; height:100vh; width:440px; max-width:92vw; background: var(--color-surface); border-left:1px solid var(--color-line); box-shadow: var(--shadow-drawer); z-index: var(--z-drawer)

regions.head: padding 18px 20px; border-bottom 1px line; title (titleSm) + endpoint context + close (×) button right
regions.foot: padding 14px 20px; border-top 1px line; Cancel (secondary) + confirm (primary), right-aligned

Drawer.a11y: role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label; trap focus while open; Escape closes; restore focus to the trigger on close; backdrop click closes.

Backdrop.style: position:fixed inset:0; background rgba(28,25,23,0.28); z-index: var(--z-backdrop); fade 180ms; pointer-events only when open

EmailPreview.desc: Read-only source-email block inside the promote drawer
EmailPreview.style: border 1px line; radius md; padding 14px; background var(--color-sunken); shows from+date (meta), subject (medium), body snippet

LabeledDivider.desc: Horizontal rule with centered uppercase label (e.g. 'Creates application')
LabeledDivider.style: flex with two 1px line rules flanking eyebrow-type text

ConfidenceBar.desc: Classifier confidence meter on review cards
ConfidenceBar.style: 6px track var(--color-fill); fill var(--color-line-strong) (or warning fg when low); width = confidence%
ConfidenceBar.context: Review queue items below a confidence threshold.

ReviewCard.layout: grid 1fr auto: left = subject + sender(meta) + ConfidenceBar + classifier note; right = stacked 'Promote to application' (primary) + 'Dismiss' (secondary)

EmptyState.style: 1.5px dashed var(--color-line-strong); radius md; padding 30px; centered meta text + optional primary action
EmptyState.copyRule: State what's empty and the single next action, in the interface's voice (e.g. 'No emails to review. New low-confidence emails will appear here.').

Toast.style: elevation popover; success border/bg from feedback; auto-dismiss ~4s; includes optional 'View application' link

Pagination.note: Bind to GET /api/v1/applications and /api/v1/emails paging params.

pages.title: Sign in
pages.layout: Centered single Card (radius lg, width ~340px) on var(--color-page).
pages.behavior: On success store token, fetch GET /api/v1/auth/me, redirect to /dashboard. On failure show inline error (danger) above the form — explain what to fix, no apology.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.subtitle: Overview of your job search pipeline
pages.layout: metrics grid, then splitWide (line chart | donut), then splitWide (recent applications table | top companies BarList).

pages.title: Applications
pages.subtitle: Every role you've applied to
pages.layout: Toolbar (search + status FilterPills) then a Card-wrapped Table with Pagination.

pages.title: {company} — {role}
pages.subtitle: Application #{id}
pages.layout: PageHeader with Back (secondary) + Save changes (primary); detail grid: editable form Card | linked email Timeline Card.

sections.component: KeyValueList (editable: Status Select, Company, Role, Location, Source, Notes)

pages.title: Emails
pages.subtitle: All ingested & classified messages
pages.layout: Toolbar (search + classification/linked filters) then Card-wrapped Table with a trailing action column.

sections.behavior: If unlinked: 'Promote →' secondary button opens the promote Drawer. If linked: 'Linked' muted label that links to the application.

pages.title: Review queue
pages.subtitle: Low-confidence classifications needing a human decision
pages.layout: Vertical stack of ReviewCards; EmptyState when none.

pages.title: Jobs & workers
pages.subtitle: Trigger ingestion runs and tune the worker
pages.layout: jobControls grid (3 action Cards), then splitEqual (recent jobs Table | system stats MetricCards).

sections.component: Action Card: Check for new email
Action Card: Worker email limit (number input)

sections.behavior: Poll running jobs (React Query refetchInterval) until terminal status.

promoteFlow.summary: The promote-email-to-application action is reachable from BOTH the Emails table (per-row 'Promote →') and the Review queue cards. Both open the same right-side Drawer so the user keeps their place in the list.
drawerContents: KeyValueList prefilled from classifier extraction: Company, Role, Status (Select), Source
hint: fields are editable before promoting

confirm.onSuccess: close drawer, show success Toast with 'View application' link, invalidate emails + applications + dashboard queries
confirm.onError: keep drawer open, show inline danger message

endpoints.purpose: Service health for the status indicator.
Create an application from an email.

accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements: 2px solid var(--color-accent), offset 2px. Never remove outlines without a replacement.
accessibility.color: Maintain WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 text). Status is never conveyed by color alone — always pair with a text label.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard operability. Drawer traps focus, closes on Escape, restores focus to its trigger.
accessibility.semantics: Real <table>, <button> vs <a> by behavior, <label> tied to every input, aria-current on active nav, aria-live='polite' on toasts.
accessibility.motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — disable drawer/transition animations.

implementationNotes.tokenConsumption: Generate the cssVariables block into a global :root in index.css, or map tokens into tailwind.config.ts theme.extend (colors, fontFamily, borderRadius, boxShadow, zIndex). Reference variables — do not hardcode hex in components.
suggestedStructure: src/hooks/                   (React Query hooks per endpoint, e.g. useApplications, useDashboardMetrics)
src/components/ui/           (Button, Input, Select, Card, Table, StatusBadge, Drawer, etc.)
src/components/             (composite: Sidebar, Topbar, MetricCard, ReviewCard, PromoteDrawer)
src/pages/                  (Login, Dashboard, Applications, ApplicationDetail, Emails, ReviewQueue, JobsAdmin)
implementationNotes.dataLayer: One React Query hook per endpoint. Mutations (PUT application, promote email, job triggers) invalidate the relevant query keys: promote invalidates ['emails'], ['emails','review'], ['applications'], ['dashboard'].
implementationNotes.statesContract: Every data-bound section must implement three states: loading (skeleton matching the final layout — gray bars at token sizes), empty (designed EmptyState), error (inline danger message with a retry action). No raw spinners on full pages where a skeleton fits.
